meta.name: tdd
meta.description: Test-driven development. Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions "red-green-refactor", or wants integration tests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用测试先行方式开发新功能并修复缺陷
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是开发时习惯先写测试、再让代码通过的工程师
copy.tagline_en: Build features and fix bugs test-first
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you practice red-green-refactor and want tests to drive your code

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按 red→green 循环做事：先写失败的测试，再写刚好让它通过的代码，一次一个切片。测试只写在事先与你确认的公共接口（seam）上，不测内部实现。
howto.when: 当你想用测试先行的方式开发功能或修 bug、提到“red-green-refactor”，或想要集成测试时触发。

say.text: 用 TDD 帮我加一个结算功能
say.note: 它会先和你确认要测的公共接口

say.text: 先用一个失败测试复现这个 bug，再修
say.note: 先红后绿，一次一个切片

say.text: 按 red-green-refactor 来，测试只写在公共接口上
say.note: 测试留在接缝处，不碰内部实现

howto.what_en: Claude works in the red→green loop: a failing test first, then only enough code to pass it, one slice at a time. Tests are written at seams you confirm up front.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to build features or fix bugs test-first, mention "red-green-refactor", or want integration tests.

say_en.text: Use TDD to add a checkout feature
say_en.note: It confirms the seams to test first

say_en.text: Reproduce this bug with a failing test, then fix it
say_en.note: Red before green, one slice at a time

say_en.text: Follow red-green-refactor; test only at public interfaces
say_en.note: Tests stay at seams, not internals
